notes: iCloud Drive cannot stream publicly (auth + CORS). Keep masters in iCloud, sync the same tree to a public host, then set baseUrl.
Recommended public hosts: Cloudflare R2, AWS S3, Backblaze B2, Bunny Storage, or any static file host with CORS enabled for vcrrecords.com.
Suggested layout (mirror in iCloud and public bucket): releases/<release-id>/preview.mp3, 01-track.mp3, download.zip
Set baseUrl to the public origin that contains those folders, e.g. https://media.vcrrecords.com/releases
Each release uses mediaFolder (defaults to release id). Preview, track files, and digital downloads all resolve from that same folder.
Until baseUrl is set, the site falls back to local/legacy audio files in the repo.
